description: Four channels of CV shaping, each with an inverter, an attenuator, a sample and hold, a VCA, a low-pass filter, a slew limiter, an offset and AC coupling

params.text: Attenuates that channel's input, from nothing through to full level
Flips the sign of that channel's input before anything else in the channel
Fully counter-clockwise the channel passes unfiltered; turning clockwise lowers the cutoff of the low-pass filter
Sets how slowly the channel climbs towards a rising input, 10000V per second fully counter-clockwise and 0.1V per second fully clockwise
Sets how slowly the channel falls towards a dropping input, 10000V per second fully counter-clockwise and 0.1V per second fully clockwise
Bends the slew shape of that channel: fully clockwise gives a constant rate, and turning counter-clockwise slows the approach as the output nears the input
Bends the VCA response of that channel, exponential fully counter-clockwise and linear fully clockwise
Adds a fixed -5V to 5V to that channel after the slew limiter
AC strips any steady voltage out of the output with a very slow averaging filter; DC leaves the output as it is

inputs.text: The voltage that channel shapes; with nothing patched the channel starts from 0V
Sets the gain of that channel: 0V silences it, 5V passes it unchanged and 10V doubles it; with nothing patched the channel passes at full level
A rising edge samples that channel's input and holds it until the next edge; with nothing patched the input passes through unheld

outputs.text: The finished first channel, clamped to -10V to 10V
The finished channel, clamped to -10V to 10V, with the output of the channel before it added in whenever that channel's own jack is empty
